# Christoferson Chua

> Cloud & generative AI architect and engineering manager with 20+ years in enterprise software and a strong Java background (since 2003). Leads an in-house team that delivers cloud and generative AI solutions on AWS, from proofs of concept with business teams through design, implementation and CI/CD. Holds 13 active AWS certifications plus Microsoft and ISC2 credentials. Bilingual in English and Japanese.

- Website: https://christoferson.github.io/
- About, skills and certifications: https://christoferson.github.io/about.html
- GitHub: https://github.com/christoferson (150 public repositories)
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/christofersonchua/
- Credly (verifiable badges): https://www.credly.com/users/christoferson-chua

## Focus areas

- Generative AI & agents: Amazon Bedrock, RAG with Bedrock Knowledge Bases, Strands Agents, Bedrock AgentCore, MCP, Claude Agent SDK and OpenAI Agents SDK, AI-assisted development with Claude Code.
- Cloud architecture on AWS: infrastructure as code (CloudFormation, CDK, SAM), containers on ECS and EKS, serverless, networking, security, CI/CD (CodePipeline, CodeBuild).
- Backend engineering: Java and Spring Boot services, Python APIs with FastAPI, enterprise integrations, layered design and testing.
- Full-stack AI apps: TypeScript and Next.js applications on Bedrock (streaming chat, document Q&A with citations, voice, vision, content generation).

## Featured projects

- [Secure AI agent deployment on AgentCore](https://github.com/christoferson/aws-bedrock-agentcore-cfn): CI/CD pipeline that builds each change to a Strands agent into an ARM64 container and deploys it to AgentCore Runtime in private subnets via PrivateLink; four layered CloudFormation stacks (IAM, network, CI/CD, runtime).
- [Document Q&A with cited answers (RAG)](https://github.com/christoferson/next-js-app-jit-rag): NotebookLM-style app with streaming answers grounded in uploaded documents and page-level citations; pluggable chunking strategies. TypeScript, Next.js, Amazon Bedrock, LanceDB.
- [On-brand deck studio](https://github.com/christoferson/next-js-app-slides): Bedrock writes slide content as structured JSON while brand configurations own all visuals; outline, per-slide streaming generation and PPTX export.
- [Amazon Bedrock prototyping app](https://github.com/christoferson/streamlit-demo): 40+ working Streamlit demos for prototyping generative AI on Bedrock (chat and tool use, RAG over Knowledge Bases and S3 Vectors, document and image Q&A, image generation).
- [Multi-tool AI agent with live web search](https://github.com/christoferson/streamlit-strands-agent): Strands agent on Bedrock that picks tools per question: web search with cited sources (Nova web grounding), image generation, calculator, time lookup.
- [AWS CloudFormation template library](https://github.com/christoferson/aws-cloudformation): 400+ templates across 70+ AWS services, maintained since 2021, including Bedrock, Knowledge Bases and AgentCore.

The full, searchable list of public projects (AI agents, Bedrock, IaC, AWS SDKs, Java and Spring, TypeScript, Python, ML) is on the [projects page](https://christoferson.github.io/#projects).
